# Getting Help with LumenRail

Thanks for using LumenRail! Here's where to get help:

## 📖 Documentation

- **[README](../README.md)** — Project overview, features, and quickstart
- **[CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)** — How to contribute
- **[Architecture Guide](../docs/architecture.md)** — System design and component overview
- **[Integration Guide](../docs/integration-guide.md)** — How to integrate LumenRail into your app
- **[Mainnet Deployment](../docs/deployment-mainnet.md)** — Production deployment checklist

## 🐛 Bug Reports & Feature Requests

- **Bug?** → [Open a bug report](https://github.com/Abolax123/OphirPay/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)
- **Feature idea?** → [Open a feature request](https://github.com/Abolax123/OphirPay/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml)

## 💬 Community

- **GitHub Discussions** → Ask questions, share ideas, show off your builds
- **Stellar Developer Discord** → `#lumenrail` channel for real-time chat

## 🔒 Security

Found a security vulnerability? Please do **NOT** open a public issue.

→ See our **[Security Policy](../SECURITY.md)** for responsible disclosure.

## 💰 Sponsorship

LumenRail is open-source and community-funded. If it saves you time or powers your project, consider [sponsoring us](https://github.com/sponsors/LumenRail).

## 📧 Contact

- **General inquiries**: hello@lumenrail.dev
- **Security**: security@lumenrail.dev
- **Conduct issues**: conduct@lumenrail.dev
